title: Exporting for Linux
key_points: Godot offers a way to distribute games for PC using the export system.
When exporting for Linux, the exporter creates a 'data.pck' file and a specially optimized binary.
There are 7 different processor architectures that exported Godot projects can run on in Linux.
limitations: x86_32 executables should not be used unless trying to get the project to run on an old 32bit distribution and processor.
rv64, ppc64, and loongarch64 architectures are substantially more niche when it comes to running videogames on them.
asserts: Godot provides a method to export projects for Linux, creating a 'data.pck' file and an optimized binary that can run on various processor architectures.
